findings.title: js-yaml 4.3.1 high-severity DoS vulnerability in frontend devDependencies
findings.detail: js-yaml 4.3.1 (installed via @eslint/eslintrc in frontend devDependencies) is affected by GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh: maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources (CVSS 7.5, CWE-400/407). Vulnerable range: >=4.0.0 <4.3.2. A fix is available via npm audit fix.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm audit fix` in the frontend/ directory to update js-yaml to >=4.3.2 in package-lock.json

findings.title: sharp <0.35.4 high-severity libheif vulnerability in worker devDependencies (via wrangler/miniflare)
findings.detail: sharp (transitively required by miniflare which is required by wrangler 4.125.0) is affected by GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c: Vulnerabilities in libheif (GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 and GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545). Vulnerable range: <0.35.4. This is a devDependency chain (wrangler -> miniflare -> sharp). Bumping wrangler to the latest 4.131.1 may pull in a fixed miniflare/sharp.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm audit fix` in the worker/ directory to update sharp/miniflare via wrangler bump

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18.x installed, 19.3.0 available)
findings.detail: frontend/package.json pins react and react-dom at ^18.2.0 (installed 18.3.1). Latest release is 19.3.0. This is a major version bump requiring manual review of breaking changes and React 19 migration guide.
findings.suggested_fix: Update react and react-dom to ^19.3.0 in frontend/package.json and run npm install, then test the overlay
